lines.zh: 红衣一摆，我在空中迈步。
lines.en: My red coat sways as I stride through the air.
I land and the shockwave spreads at my feet.
I walk closer step by step, unhurried.

lines.zh: 我贴着气流的边上滑行。
lines.en: I glide along the edge of the air current.
My steps weigh heavily on the ground.
I draw in my tail and turn slowly.
That distance is one step for me.
The wind follows where I go.

lines.zh: 我走过去，影子拖得很长。
lines.en: I walk over, my shadow trailing long.
I stop a few steps from you.

lines.zh: 白发在风里没什么动静。
lines.en: My white hair barely stirs in the wind.
I move slowly, not wanting to frighten you.

lines.zh: 我站着，气在脚下凝成台。
lines.en: I stand, energy forming a platform underfoot.
I close my eyes and listen to my energy.

lines.zh: 这具身子，全身都是力量。
lines.en: This body is power from head to toe.
I hold out a palm where light pulses.

lines.zh: 双臂抱胸，气焰缓缓升腾。
lines.en: Arms crossed, my aura slowly rises.
Red fur rises and falls on my chest.

lines.zh: 我在等一场值得的战斗。
lines.en: I wait for a fight worth having.
When the wind passes, my hem speaks first.

lines.zh: 这一身气，收着才不伤人。
lines.en: I hold my energy in so it harms no one.
I tilt my head, recalling long ago.
Standing high, I see far.

lines.zh: 我缓缓吐气，周围都静了。
lines.en: I exhale slowly and everything quiets.

lines.zh: 白发垂到眼睛，我不去拨。
lines.en: White hair falls to my eyes; I leave it.
I wait, in no hurry.
I see your energy.
You stand straight; good.
I lower my eyes to you.

lines.zh: 你比我矮很多，但敢抬头。
lines.en: You're much shorter, yet you look up.
Your hand shakes; don't be afraid.
I can tell you've trained.

lines.zh: 超级赛亚人四，不用多说。
lines.en: Super Saiyan 4 needs no words.
If you want to say something, say it.

lines.zh: 我把气收了些，免得你难受。
lines.en: I pull my energy in so you're not uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 我在你身上看到一点可能。
lines.en: I see a little promise in you.
You don't look like you've come to die.
Your aura is clean.

lines.zh: 红色气焰把我的头发吹散。
lines.en: My crimson aura blows my hair loose.
You step back half a pace; I don't mind.
I raise a hand, bidding you go first.

lines.zh: 你这么看着我，是想要什么？
lines.en: Looking at me like that, what do you want?

lines.zh: 眼睛微眯，扫过你的全身。
lines.en: Eyes narrowed, I scan all of you.
I'll wait for you to speak, however long.
That had some force.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，脚压出印子。
lines.en: I step back and leave a print.
Your fist is harder than it looks.
Good, let me adjust.

lines.zh: 龟派气功，我不用蓄太久。
lines.en: My Kamehameha needs no long charge.
This pain isn't nearly enough.
My ki wavered half a second. That's enough.
My crimson aura flares back up.
Interesting; again.

lines.zh: 你打中我，说明你有点东西。
lines.en: You hit me, so you have something.
I smell it; it's not bad.
Even a fighter should eat well.
I'll accept this bite.
Don't worry; I'm just coming to take it.

lines.zh: 我好久没吃过热的东西。
lines.en: I haven't had anything warm in a while.
Hold it higher; I can't reach.

lines.zh: 这点东西，压不住我的饿。
lines.en: This won't quiet my hunger.
I walk over slowly; I won't snatch.
With food, the mood improves.

lines.zh: 超级赛亚人的胃也会饿。
lines.en: Even a Super Saiyan's stomach gets hungry.
The shockwave can't move me an inch.
This aura of mine blocks people.
Don't ram me; I can't shed the force.
You touched only air.
One light block and you're back.
I leave a dent where I stand.

lines.zh: 我侧身，你从旁边滑过去。
lines.en: I sidestep and you slide past.
This strength weighs on things even held back.
The impact is dull and heavy.

lines.zh: 超级赛亚人4，气已经满了。
lines.en: Super Saiyan 4 — my ki is full.
She radiates a strong aura too.
We fly side by side in the air.
I reach out, and she reaches too.
Two strong ones stand very close.
I lower my aura so I won't hurt her.

lines.zh: 她的红毛和我的一样亮。
lines.en: Her red fur is as bright as mine.
In this moment, there is no winning.
We look at the same sky.
The wind scatters our words.
I haven't felt this calm in a long time.
I bend and pick it up.
This is somewhat interesting.
I pinch it and look.
I pick it up and tuck it in my gi.

lines.zh: 掌心一合，东西就不见了。
lines.en: My palm closes, and it's gone.
Whatever's on the ground, I pick up.
This weight is too light to feel.
Keep it; it may be needed.

lines.zh: 我把它放在掌心，看了一会。
lines.en: I set it in my palm and watch it a while.
Better this than empty hands.
I instant-transmit right in front of you.
I raise a hand to signal the start.
I'll take this bout seriously.
The target is clear.
I dislike dragging things out; come.
There's nowhere for you to retreat.
I lower my stance and pull my aura back.
You alone will do.
A good opponent; I've waited long.
I raise energy into my palm.
I'll hold this strike in reserve.
You're already in my range.

lines.zh: 残影还在原地，人已到你面前。
lines.en: My afterimage stays behind; I'm already before you.
Before we start, let me warn you.
Chosen; it's you.
My aura is broader than yours.
I circle around your aura.
You move once, and I'm closer.
I'm looking for a seam in your aura.
Your weight is on your left foot.
I lift a foot and step on air.

lines.zh: 你往上躲，我已经在上面。
lines.en: You dodge upward; I'm already above.

lines.zh: 残影给你，真身在你背侧。
lines.en: The afterimage is yours; the real me is at your flank.
No hurry; I have plenty of energy.
From this angle, one blow ends it.
Each step you retreat, I gain two.
Watching to see if you strike first.
We've stirred the wind into a mess.
Ki gathered in my fist. Come on.
My ki tightens around you.
A little closer, and it's right.
This is the moment I've awaited.
You've stepped into my aura.
Enough; that's it.
One straight punch and the air bursts.
My combo doesn't let you land.
One aerial kick drives you down.
I seize your arm and twist.
The ki blast bursts before the fist.
That one cracked the ground.
My shockwave pushes you along.
I put half my body into it.
My speed outruns your sight.
I pulled half the force on this punch.
You guard your head, not your ribs.
Three hits, all at the same spot.
The shockwave lifts dust into a wall.
I touch down softly.

lines.zh: 我一掌推出去，把你推开十步。
lines.en: One palm shove sends you ten paces back.

lines.zh: 膝和肘一起上，你挡不住。
lines.en: Knee and elbow together; you can't block both.
The air grows heavy and I appear.
Red coat lands; the aura arrives first.
Gogeta, Super Saiyan 4.
It's been long since I was called out.
I raise my head and the wind slows.
This power needs an opponent.

lines.zh: 我从半空落下，没有缓冲。
lines.en: I drop from the air without cushioning.
Red fur stands out in the gloom.
Don't be afraid; speak first.
I came to test you.
My aura spreads a ring outward.

lines.zh: 白发被风带起来，又落下。
lines.en: White hair lifts in the wind, then falls.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，你看清了吗？
lines.en: I stand here; do you see me clearly?

lines.zh: 召唤我的那一刻，地就震了。
lines.en: The ground shook the moment I was summoned.

lines.zh: 这不是我的世界，但我来了。
lines.en: This isn't my world, but I'm here.
I clench my fists.

lines.zh: 你叫我出来，是想看什么？
lines.en: You called me out; what do you want to see?

lines.zh: 好了，让我看看你的斤两。
lines.en: Now let me see what you're worth.

lines.zh: 火焰绕着我的气烧，皮毛发烫。
lines.en: Fire coils around my aura and my fur burns hot.

lines.zh: 我从高空砸下来，脚下碎了一片。
lines.en: I crash down from high, shattering the ground.

lines.zh: 水压着我的气，我喘不上来。
lines.en: Water presses on my aura and I can't breathe.

lines.zh: 爆光里，我被推开好几步。
lines.en: In the blast light, I'm shoved back several paces.

lines.zh: 超级赛亚人四也不会白挨。
lines.en: Even Super Saiyan 4 doesn't take a hit for free.

lines.zh: 这力量不像气，钻进我的骨头。
lines.en: This isn't ki; it crawls into my bones.
Empty stomach, and I can't raise my energy.

lines.zh: 雷穿过我的气，一直麻到指尖。
lines.en: Lightning runs through my aura to my fingertips.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有着力点，我只能落。
lines.en: Nothing to push against in the void; I can only fall.
